# Content Provenance, Access and Attribution: A Field Guide

> 81 cards for the organizations, working groups, specifications and proposals that decide where content came from (provenance), what may be done with it (access, licensing, payment) and whether its source gets credited (attribution), and where the Model Context Protocol fits among them. Compiled by Ola Hungerford, as of 2026-11-22.

This field guide is an early alpha, shared for feedback. Card fields, the MCP tools, the plugin layout and the published file formats may change. Send feedback as an issue or pull request at https://github.com/olaservo/content-provenance-cards. One person's working notes. Status lines carry the dates the sources gave, so check upstream before relying on one. The cards are licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/): reuse them with credit to Ola Hungerford and a link to the guide. Each card has a name, type, status, website, tags (layer, stage, medium, topic, type), a short summary, topic sections, a dated history where one is known, links to related cards and, where the effort names them, public places to take part: Contribute (issue tracker, repository or join page), Discussion (chat, forum or mailing list) and Meetings (public calendar or list of open calls). A link under a card's Compare heading is a comparison made by this guide. Every other link is a connection that a primary source states.

## One card at a time

A prototype at https://content-provenance-field-guide.olahungerford.workers.dev/ serves each card as its own file. It is experimental and its address may move.

- [Guide index](https://content-provenance-field-guide.olahungerford.workers.dev/index.md): the layer and stage definitions and one line per card. One card is at https://content-provenance-field-guide.olahungerford.workers.dev/cards/<id>.md
- [Field guide skill](https://content-provenance-field-guide.olahungerford.workers.dev/skills/content-provenance-field-guide/SKILL.md): how to answer questions from the guide, loading only the cards a question needs
- [More for agents](https://content-provenance-field-guide.olahungerford.workers.dev/llms.txt): the cards by layer, the contributor and feedback skills and an MCP server
- [Plugin](https://github.com/olaservo/content-provenance-cards#start-here): the skills and the MCP server for Codex and Claude Code

## Updates and topics

- [Updates](https://www.olahungerford.com/content-provenance/updates.md): dated events from every card's history, newest first, also as [JSON](https://www.olahungerford.com/content-provenance/updates.json)
- [Topic: skills](https://www.olahungerford.com/content-provenance/topics/skills.md): the cards tagged topic/skills
- [Topic: discovery](https://www.olahungerford.com/content-provenance/topics/discovery.md): the cards tagged topic/discovery
- [Topic: lineage](https://www.olahungerford.com/content-provenance/topics/lineage.md): the cards tagged topic/lineage

## All cards in one file

- [All cards as Markdown](https://www.olahungerford.com/content-provenance/cards.md): every card in one file of about 195 KB, one section per card, with the layer and stage definitions first
- [All cards as JSON](https://www.olahungerford.com/content-provenance/cards.json): the same cards as structured data, with the vocabularies under "vocab"

## Optional

- [Explorer](https://www.olahungerford.com/content-provenance/): the list and graph view for people
- [Not connected yet](https://www.olahungerford.com/content-provenance/matches.md): pairs of cards the guide compares and no primary source connects
- [Watch list](https://www.olahungerford.com/content-provenance/watch.md): where each effort posts its news, with feeds, plus sources that have no card, also as [JSON](https://www.olahungerford.com/content-provenance/watch.json)
- [Changelog](https://www.olahungerford.com/content-provenance/changelog.md): cards added and changed in the guide, by date
- [About the author](https://www.olahungerford.com/about/)
